import * as T from 'three';
import {applyBandUV} from '../../../utils/GeometryUV.js';
const SOURCE='https://www.dpm.org.cn/explore/building/236529.html',PHOTO='https://img.dpm.org.cn/Uploads/Picture/2020/04/20/s5e9d44914e7f1.jpg';
function opaque(m){return m.visible===true&&m.transparent===false&&m.opacity===1&&m.alphaTest===0&&!m.alphaMap&&!m.alphaHash&&m.depthWrite===true&&m.depthTest===true&&m.colorWrite===true&&m.side===T.FrontSide&&m.blending===T.NormalBlending&&!m.wireframe;}
const scalar=(a,b)=>Number.isFinite(a)&&Math.abs(a-b)<1e-10;
function geometryEqual(a,b){return a.morphTargetsRelative===b.morphTargetsRelative&&Object.keys(a.morphAttributes).length===0&&a.drawRange.start===0&&a.drawRange.count===Infinity&&JSON.stringify(a.groups)===JSON.stringify(b.groups)&&Object.keys(a.attributes).sort().join()===Object.keys(b.attributes).sort().join()&&Object.entries(b.attributes).every(([k,v])=>{const p=a.attributes[k];return p.itemSize===v.itemSize&&p.normalized===v.normalized&&p.array.constructor===v.array.constructor&&p.array.length===v.array.length&&p.array.every((n,i)=>n===v.array[i]);})&&!!a.index===!!b.index&&(!b.index||a.index.itemSize===b.index.itemSize&&a.index.normalized===b.index.normalized&&a.index.array.constructor===b.index.array.constructor&&a.index.count===b.index.count&&a.index.array.every((v,i)=>v===b.index.array[i]));}
function canonical(o){return o.visible===true&&o.matrixAutoUpdate===true&&o.matrixWorldAutoUpdate===true&&o.scale.equals(new T.Vector3(1,1,1));}
function meshMatches(m,{name,w,h,d,x,y,z,material,rotation=0,band},kit){if(!m?.isMesh||m.name!==name||!canonical(m)||m.children.length||m.rotation.x||m.rotation.z||m.rotation.y!==rotation||!scalar(m.position.x,x)||!scalar(m.position.y,y)||!scalar(m.position.z,z)||m.material!==material||!material||Array.isArray(material)||!opaque(material))return false;let ref=new T.BoxGeometry(w,h,d);try{if(band)ref=applyBandUV(ref,kit.lib.tileSize('lattice_doors'));return geometryEqual(m.geometry,ref);}finally{ref.dispose();}}
function canAddMetadata(record){if(!Object.isExtensible(record))return false;for(let o=record;o;o=Object.getPrototypeOf(o))if(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(o,'tiheSouthVisual'))return false;return true;}
function textureMaterial(kit,name,width,draw){const canvas=typeof document==='undefined'?null:document.createElement('canvas');if(canvas){canvas.width=width;canvas.height=512;}const context=canvas?.getContext('2d');if(context)draw(context,width,512);const texture=context?new T.CanvasTexture(canvas):null;if(texture){texture.colorSpace=T.SRGBColorSpace;texture.anisotropy=4;texture.name=name+'-schematic';}const material=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({name,color:0xffffff,map:texture,roughness:.84,transparent:false,opacity:1,depthWrite:true});material.userData={source:PHOTO,exactCarving:false,opaqueSourcePreserved:true};material.addEventListener('dispose',()=>texture?.dispose());kit.owned.push(material);return material;}
function panelPattern(c,w,h,width,upper){const panelW=width-.12,panelH=upper-.08,splitV=(upper*.48-.04)/panelH,splitY=(1-splitV)*h,centres=[(width/3-.06)/panelW,(width*2/3-.06)/panelW],edges=[.06/panelW,...centres,1-.06/panelW];c.fillStyle='#743626';c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const left=edges[k]*w+4,right=edges[k+1]*w-4,ww=right-left;c.fillStyle='#251f1b';c.fillRect(left,3,ww,splitY-5);c.strokeStyle='#8b402a';c.lineWidth=4;for(const inset of[5,13,21]){const a=left+inset,b=right-inset,top=4+inset,bottom=splitY-7-inset,mid=(a+b)/2,step=8;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a,bottom);c.lineTo(a,top);c.lineTo(mid-step,top);c.lineTo(mid-step,top+step);c.lineTo(mid+step,top+step);c.lineTo(mid+step,top);c.lineTo(b,top);c.lineTo(b,bottom);c.lineTo(mid+step,bottom);c.lineTo(mid+step,bottom-step);c.lineTo(mid-step,bottom-step);c.lineTo(mid-step,bottom);c.closePath();c.stroke();}c.fillStyle=['#393a36','#353431','#3e3c37'][k];c.fillRect(left,splitY+2,ww,h-splitY-5);c.fillStyle='#454641';c.fillRect(left+ww*.12,splitY+5,ww*.07,h-splitY-11);c.strokeStyle='#71372a';c.lineWidth=3;c.strokeRect(left,splitY+2,ww,h-splitY-5);}return{splitV,mullionU:centres,panelWidth:panelW,panelHeight:panelH};}
function doorPattern(c,w,h){c.fillStyle='#4a3a2a';c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);c.strokeStyle='#756044';c.lineWidth=7;for(const x of[.10,.51]){c.fillStyle='#2f302b';c.fillRect(w*x,h*.09,w*.37,h*.44);c.strokeRect(w*x,h*.09,w*.37,h*.44);c.fillStyle='#564430';c.fillRect(w*x,h*.59,w*.37,h*.33);c.strokeRect(w*x,h*.59,w*.37,h*.33);}/* photographed brown paneled relationship only; not closed leaf count or precise carving */}
/** Material-only: every original render/source geometry, UV and opaque body remains. */
export function applyTiheSouthVisual(kit,item,f,p){
 if(p?.key!=='tihe-through-hall'||kit.root.name!=='west-six'||item.name!=='翊坤宫后殿'||item.x!==94||item.z!==401.5||item.w!==26.2||item.d!==12.9||item.ph!==.45||item.colH!==6.08||item.bays!==5||item.backDoor!==true||item.rot!==undefined||f.parent!==kit.root||!canonical(kit.root)||kit.root.parent!==null||kit.root.position.lengthSq()||kit.root.rotation.x||kit.root.rotation.y||kit.root.rotation.z||!canonical(f)||!scalar(f.position.x,94)||!scalar(f.position.z,401.5)||f.position.y||f.rotation.x||f.rotation.y||f.rotation.z||f.userData.structure?.profile!=='tihe-through-hall'||!f.userData.tiheWest||f.userData.tiheSouthVisual)throw Error('Exact registered Tihe south finish host required');
 if(!canAddMetadata(f.userData)||!canAddMetadata(f.userData.structure))throw Error('Writable Tihe south finish metadata required');
 const bay=26.2/5,width=bay-.68,height=(6.08-6.08*.12)*.8,floor=.45,z=-12.9/2,upper=height-.95,mid=floor+.95+upper/2,wood=kit.lib.material('wood_column'),paper=kit.owned.find(m=>m.name==='r48_tihe-through-hall_schematic_lattice'),brick=kit.lib.material('wall_brick'),groups=f.children.filter(g=>g.name==='r48-residential-window'&&g.userData.side===-1),targets=[];
 if(groups.length!==4)throw Error('Tihe requires all four original south windows');
 for(const[index,g]of groups.entries()){const bayIndex=[0,1,3,4][index],x=-26.2/2+(bayIndex+.5)*bay;if(g.userData.bayIndex!==bayIndex||g.userData.catalogId!=='place-west-six-c08ecd0452'||!canonical(g)||g.position.lengthSq()||g.rotation.x||g.rotation.y||g.rotation.z||g.children.length!==9)throw Error('Tihe original window identity changed');
  const rows=[['sill',width,.95,.38,x,floor+.475,z,brick],['panel',width-.12,upper-.08,.06,x,mid,z,paper],...[-1,1].map(sign=>['jamb',.12,upper,.16,x+sign*(width-.12)/2,mid,z-.055,wood]),...[floor+.95+.05,floor+height-.05].map(y=>['rail',width,.1,.16,x,y,z-.055,wood]),...[1,2].map(k=>['mullion',.08,upper,.13,x-width/2+k*width/3,mid,z-.06,wood]),['transom',width,.09,.13,x,floor+.95+upper*.48,z-.06,wood]];
  for(let k=0;k<rows.length;k++){const[role,w,h,d,x,y,z,material]=rows[k];if(!meshMatches(g.children[k],{name:'r48-residential-window-'+role,w,h,d,x,y,z,material},kit))throw Error('Tihe original window source changed: '+bayIndex+'/'+role);if(k)targets.push({m:g.children[k],kind:k===1?'panel':'frame'});}
 }
 const doorMaterial=kit.lib.material('lattice_doors'),leaves=f.children.filter(m=>m.isMesh&&m.material===doorMaterial&&m.rotation.y===Math.PI/2&&m.position.z<0);
 if(leaves.length!==2)throw Error('Tihe requires two original south open leaves');
 for(const[index,m]of leaves.entries()){const sign=index===0?-1:1;if(!meshMatches(m,{name:'',w:bay*.26,h:height,d:.1,x:sign*(bay/2-.34-.08),y:floor+height/2,z:z+bay*.13+.2,material:doorMaterial,rotation:Math.PI/2,band:true},kit))throw Error('Tihe original open leaf source changed');targets.push({m,kind:'door'});}
 for(const{m}of targets)if(!['material','userData'].every(k=>Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(m,k)?.writable===true))throw Error('Writable Tihe source finish fields required');
 const startOwned=kit.owned.length;
 try{let layout;const panel=textureMaterial(kit,'tihe-south-stepped-glass-panel-fit',768,(c,w,h)=>{layout=panelPattern(c,w,h,width,upper)}),door=textureMaterial(kit,'tihe-south-brown-open-door-fit',256,doorPattern),red=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({name:'tihe-south-red-frame-fit',color:0x873b2c,roughness:.85});kit.owned.push(red);panel.userData.layout=layout??{splitV:(upper*.48-.04)/(upper-.08),mullionU:[(width/3-.06)/(width-.12),(width*2/3-.06)/(width-.12)]};
  if(door.map){door.map.repeat.set(kit.lib.tileSize('lattice_doors')/(bay*.26),1);door.map.offset.set(.5,0);door.map.updateMatrix();}
  const meta={source:SOURCE,photo:PHOTO,scope:'FOUR_COMPLETE_SOUTH_WINDOW_FINISHES_AND_TWO_OPEN_LEAF_FINISHES',windowCount:4,openLeafCount:2,geometryChanged:false,wholePalaceAccepted:false,retainedSourceBoxes:'ALL_ORIGINAL_OPAQUE_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_AND_COLLIDERS_UNCHANGED',fieldCount:'THREE_RETAINED_MODEL_FIELDS_NOT_SURVEY',lowerGlass:'OPAQUE_VISUAL_TONE_NOT_OPTICAL_TRANSMISSION',doorPose:'EXISTING_OPERATIONAL_OPEN_NOT_PHOTOGRAPH_CLOSED_STATE',unverified:['exact carving and pane proportions','photographed central leaf count','current interior/exhibition state','whole-palace physical closure','GPU visuals/performance']};
  const assignments=targets.map(({m,kind})=>({m,material:kind==='panel'?panel:kind==='door'?door:red,userData:{...m.userData,tiheSouthRole:kind==='door'?'retained-open-leaf-finish':kind,finishPhoto:PHOTO}}));
  for(const a of assignments){a.m.material=a.material;a.m.userData=a.userData;}f.userData.tiheSouthVisual=meta;f.userData.structure.tiheSouthVisual=meta;return meta;
 }catch(error){for(const m of kit.owned.slice(startOwned))m.dispose();kit.owned.length=startOwned;throw error;}
}

// Tihe's original material-selected source ordinals must be captured first.
// Queue only this exact finish, not a general postprocessing framework.
const pendingTiheSouth=new WeakMap();
export function stageTiheSouthVisual(kit,item,f,p){if(pendingTiheSouth.has(kit))throw Error('Duplicate staged Tihe south finish');pendingTiheSouth.set(kit,{item,f,p});}
export function finishTiheSouthVisual(kit){const next=pendingTiheSouth.get(kit);if(!next)return false;const result=applyTiheSouthVisual(kit,next.item,next.f,next.p);pendingTiheSouth.delete(kit);return result;}
